overall_reason: The update (etcd-raft joint consensus / ConfChangeV2, confchange.Changer, RawNode-based node loop, raft.advance auto-leave) changes the configuration representation from a single voter set to a joint config (incoming voters, outgoing voters, learners, learnersNext, autoLeave) and changes single-change semantics (AddLearner on a voter now demotes; a change that leaves zero incoming voters is refused by panic; removing an unknown peer is a no-op). The standard Raft safety controls are unchanged. Every property that reads config.voters or ConfigOf must be migrated to the joint representation. Some of these migrations are pure representation changes. Others make the old text too weak (QuorumAccounting and ConfigurationTransitionSafety only look at incoming voters) or too strong (CampaignContract, TransferContract, ProposalContract and ReadBasis exclude outgoing-only voters). EffectContract needs real semantic changes. Two properties must be added: one for transition shape/quorum overlap, and one for the pending-config discipline, because auto-leave appends conf entries outside stepLeader. The new code appears to violate several still-required properties: Hup ignores V2 entries, auto-leave does not bump pendingConfIndex, and restore/newRaft drop the joint half of the ConfState. These are reported as defects, not used to weaken the properties.

ExpectedStep is stated independently of the model fold. A node's final role is set by its last non-Update change: AddVoter -> incoming voter; AddLearner -> learnersNext if the node is in the new outgoing set, else learners; Remove -> none; no change -> unchanged. suspected_defects: numOfPendingConf (raft.go:1580) counts only EntryConfChange, so a node campaigns while a committed V2 conf change is unapplied (violates CampaignContract).

raft.advance auto-leave (raft.go:561-580) does not update pendingConfIndex after a successful append (it only does so on failure). A later Advance with applied >= pendingConfIndex appends another leave-joint entry, which panics on apply ('can't leave a non-joint config'). It also re-opens conf proposals before the leave is applied.

raft.restore (raft.go:1418-1423) and newRaft (raft.go:330-363) rebuild the config only from ConfState.Nodes/Learners and ignore NodesJoint/LearnersNext/AutoLeave. A joint config is silently turned into its incoming half, so quorums only use incoming. The restore 'found' check also ignores NodesJoint/LearnersNext.

No leader-side validation of conf proposals (leave when not joint, enter when joint, V1 or Simple in joint, zero voters). An invalid change is committed and then deterministically panics on every node at apply time (TODO in applyConfChange).
Leader demotion: AddLearner(leader) is now possible and the leader stays leader as a learner (stale comment 'We prevent demotions').
Latent: confchange.Simple returns an empty config with a nil error when checkInvariants fails. Believed unreachable.
Minor: tracker.Config.Clone drops AutoLeave (Status.Config misreports it). Learner->voter promotion no longer sets RecentActive.
unresolved_obligations: Whether raft must refuse (rewrite) structurally invalid conf proposals or whether this is a caller precondition. NoUnexpectedFatal flags the panic either way.
Auto-leave progress (the joint state is eventually left when autoLeave) is liveness and outside the invariant suite.
The node.go propc blocking rule changed (okBefore && !okAfter) and has no property. This is a model-only (WrapperLoop) update.

Model fidelity: the joint representation, V2 entries, auto-leave in Advance, restore/restart joint handling, fresh RawNode term 0, and no Fatal on unknown removal all need model actions. Only the property-relevant helpers are migrated here.
